Those agent-count results belong to the earlier acquisition; the historical D*L records include incomplete runs assigned the 180 s limit and do not describe the corrected implementation. The supplemental acquisition tested only 128 agents and did not repeat the agent-count experiment or recompute the historical exploratory ranking. Its successful movement runs experienced the blocking and unblocking events at 0.20 s and finished before the later cost changes scheduled at 30, 90, and 150 s.
